test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The passenger says to the railway clerk, “Is the train late?”

options.text: The passenger has asked the railway clerk whether the train is late.
The passenger asked the railway clerk was the train late.
The passenger asks the railway clerk was the train late.
The passenger asks the railway clerk if the train is late.

solution:
The correct answer is: **"The passenger asks the railway clerk if the train is late."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indirect speech is used to report what someone else said without using their exact words.
 
• In the question, the sentence is present tense and therefore stays the same in the reported speech.
 
• The word "**if**" is used instead of "**whether**" to indicate a question.

**Correct Sentence:** *The passenger asks the railway clerk if the train is late.* 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** uses the correct tense but uses "whether" instead of "if."
 
• **Option 2** uses the correct tense but puts the verb before the subject, which is not grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 3** uses the wrong tense, as the passenger is speaking in the present but this option reports it in the past.
